title: About This Project
text:
This project examines population growth and economic development using data from the U.S. Census Bureau.
Most of the charts use data from the American Community Survey, which estimates population, income, education, and other characteristics across the United States.
Data source: U.S. Census Bureau

title: Population Growth and Economic Development
text:
U.S. Economic Landscape Across States


This website uses data from the U.S. Census Bureau to explore population growth and economic development across the United States.



Which states have grown fastest?
